body:
2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Six arrested after £5.9m cannabis shipment tracked to Middleton address (Middleton). Six people have been arrested after police tracked a container to Heywood Old Road in Middleton during an international investigation into 590kg of cannabis.

First Bus Rochdale wins national Gold for Routes to Work scheme (Rochdale). First Bus Rochdale’s employability programme has won Gold at the UK Bus Awards after helping local young people build skills and move into work.

Weather: Heavy rain 3°C in Rochdale today.
